modules.name: scheduling
modules.description: Planned E135 public calendar and safe player inbox/ack. Owner OpenAPI/readback and a corrected server clock are required before activation.

methods.name: calendar
methods.description: Read-only, opt-in app-wide calendar. No registration or eligibility decisions.

returns.description: Read-only, opt-in app-wide calendar. No registration or eligibility decisions.

list.description: Lists intersections with [from,to), at most 31 elapsed days; ISO dates require an offset.
list.x-function: (from: string, to: string, cursor?: string | undefined, limit?: number | undefined) => Promise<SchedulingPage<CalendarOccurrence>>

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels in-flight work and drops all cursor, dedup and cached occurrence state.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Delivered events for the JWT's current player; acknowledgement is naturally idempotent.

returns.description: Delivered events for the JWT's current player; acknowledgement is naturally idempotent.

list.description: Lists the inbox; optional limit 1..100, server default, cursor at most 128 bytes.
list.x-function: (cursor?: string | undefined, limit?: number | undefined) => Promise<SchedulingPage<InboxEvent>>

ack.description: Confirms handling using the returned eventId, without tasks, payload or a request body.

methods.name: readiness
methods.description: Contract status, independent of an integrator's opt-in to exercise the owner API.

returns.description: Contract status, independent of an integrator's opt-in to exercise the owner API.

methods.name: remainingMs
methods.description: Milliseconds until end using the supplied corrected server clock; instant always returns 0.

event.description: Immutable scheduled start/end and instant marker from the owner.

start.description: Immutable UTC scheduled start, ISO 8601 with milliseconds.

end.description: Immutable UTC end; equal to start for instant occurrences.

instant.description: True exactly when end equals start.

returns.description: Nonnegative elapsed milliseconds; this does not grant participation or a reward.
